notes.title: Money Maker For Free!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I hope you are all doing well, despite these pandemic circumstances. 

I wanted to inform you all that starting Wednesday March 25th, Money Maker will be available here, on Steam, for free! This is not a decision I took very likely, especially given the amount of time and energy I put into creating the game. However, with the lack of publicity and interest Money Maker is generating ultimately counteracts my end goal - for people all around the world to try and enjoy the games I have to offer.

To this day, I find Money Maker to be a very fun, relaxing game to take your mind off of whatever you were doing for a couple hours, or to even multi task in. No matter how you slice and dice it, it is very satisfying to see your earnings per second increase and your overall net worth increase as well in parallel! I am not sure what is up with that. 

Despite the lack of attention Money Maker received, I am extremely proud of it and had an absolute blast with it! It is definitely a different "kind" of game and is completely different form my typical horror creations. However, I am still proud to call it my own :)

To that, I hope you all enjoy what Money Maker has to offer if you end up giving it a whirl! Please don't hesitate to shoot me an email, write a review or even create a discussion. I am always happy to discuss and am happy to receive as much constructive criticism as possible in order to help me progress on my future developments.

Happy gaming everyone!

Stan.T

notes.title: Money Maker is here!
notes.content:
It's definitely been a fun ride with the development of Money Maker. I had a blast. The original purpose of Money Maker was to develop something completely different from my traditional horror preference to, in a way, give myself a break from the genre; I must say, not touching horror for over 1 year now was definitely a breather. However, I now have many Ideas I want to share, with some awesome new horror games on their way!

Money Maker has over two hours of gameplay and features many interacting components to immerse the player into a gaming experience where you will constantly want to see "what's next!". 

Enjoy over 150 purchases,
Mini-games, 
Areas to explore,
and many more!

I truly hope you enjoy Money Maker, as it was a blast to create!

Stan.T
